Confident contour lines over the hatching. The panel is composed full, corner to corner. Black-and-white only; no flat fills, no cel shading, no photographic rendering, no color.

DREW is exactly the flamingo gentleman of his reference: white plumage feathered all over in fine dash-strokes with no sleeve or cuff, the long high S-curve neck and small refined head, a slender pale bill with a black outer third and a plain slit nostril, one heavy-lidded amiable eye with a clear iris and catchlight, a crisp white collar band under a small black bow tie, a V-neck knitted sweater vest with no pockets over a pale shirt, feathered hands with four fingers and a thumb and no nails, his martini within reach.
